segments.sn15.5:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn15.5:1.5: So na sukaro saṅkhātuṃ ettakāni vassāni iti vā, ettakāni vassasatāni iti vā, ettakāni vassasahassāni iti vā, ettakāni vassasatasahassāni iti vā”ti.
segments.sn15.5:2.3: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhu, mahāselo pabbato yojanaṃ āyāmena yojanaṃ vitthārena yojanaṃ ubbedhena acchinno asusiro ekagghano.
segments.sn15.5:2.4: Tamenaṃ puriso vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena kāsikena vatthena sakiṃ sakiṃ parimajjeyya.
segments.sn15.5:2.5: Khippataraṃ kho so, bhikkhu, mahāselo pabbato iminā upakkamena parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya, na tveva kappo.
segments.sn15.5:2.7: Evaṃ dīghānaṃ kho, bhikkhu, kappānaṃ neko kappo saṃsito, nekaṃ kappasataṃ saṃsitaṃ, nekaṃ kappasahassaṃ saṃsitaṃ, nekaṃ kappasatasahassaṃ saṃsitaṃ.
segments.sn15.5:2.11: yāvañcidaṃ, bhikkhu, alameva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ, alaṃ virajjituṃ, alaṃ vimuccitun”ti.

lines: Pañcame sakkā pana, bhanteti so kira bhikkhu cintesi –
“satthā anamataggassa saṃsārassa dīghatamattā ‘na sukaraṃ na sukaran’ti kathetiyeva, kathaṃ nacchindati, sakkā nu kho upamaṃ kārāpetun”ti.
Kāsikenāti tayo kappāsaṃsū ekato gahetvā kantitasuttamayena atisukhumavatthena.
“Anamataggassa saṃsārassa dīghatamattā na sukaraṃ nasukaran”ti aṭṭhakathāpāṭho.
Kathaṃ nacchindatīti kathaṃ na pariyosāpeti, kāyacipi gahaṇatāyāti adhippāyo.
Yehi naṃ phuṭṭhaṃ, tatopi sukhumataraṃ sāsapamattaṃ khīyeyya pabbataṃ sabbabhāgehi aticiravelaṃ parimajjante.
